findings.title: Product image URLs are relative instead of absolute
findings.description: All Product schema image properties use relative paths (e.g., `/images/products/...`) instead of absolute URLs (e.g., `https://www.bazaarnow.net/images/products/...`). Google requires absolute URLs for image properties to display in rich results.
findings.recommendation: Prepend `https://www.bazaarnow.net` to all image URLs in Product schema blocks. Example: change `/images/products/foo-1.jpg` to `https://www.bazaarnow.net/images/products/foo-1.jpg`.

findings.title: Blog posts missing from sitemap.xml
findings.description: The sitemap contains 1,979 URLs but zero blog post URLs. Blog posts exist at paths like `/blog/cash-on-delivery-pakistan-online-shopping/` but are not listed in the sitemap. Google cannot discover these pages through the sitemap, significantly reducing crawl priority.
findings.recommendation: Add all blog post pages to the sitemap. There are at least 10 blog posts (discovered from the blog listing page). Each should have an appropriate `<lastmod>`, `<changefreq>`, and `<priority>`.

findings.title: Organization logo URL returns HTTP 404
findings.description: The `logo` property points to `https://www.bazaarnow.net/images/logo.png` which returns HTTP 404. This breaks the organization identity in Google Knowledge Panel and rich results.
findings.recommendation: Either restore the logo image at the current path or update the schema `logo` URL to point to a valid image.

findings.title: Missing AggregateRating on Product schema
findings.description: No Product schema includes `aggregateRating` or `review` properties. These are required for product review star rich results in Google SERP and are highly weighted by AI/LLM systems using schema data.
findings.recommendation: If any review/rating system exists, add `aggregateRating` with `ratingValue` and `reviewCount`. If not, implement a review system and add the markup.

findings.title: Missing @id and url in Product schema
findings.description: Product schema blocks lack both `@id` and `url` properties. Google uses these to correlate the product with its canonical page. Without them, the product entity is disconnected from the page context.
findings.recommendation: Add both: `"@id": "https://www.bazaarnow.net/product/SLUG/#product"` and `"url": "https://www.bazaarnow.net/product/SLUG/"` to every Product schema block.

findings.title: Missing WebSite schema with SearchAction
findings.description: No WebSite schema exists anywhere on the site. Adding WebSite with SearchAction enables the Sitelinks Search Box in Google SERP, allowing users to search the site directly from search results.
findings.recommendation: Add the WebSite + SearchAction schema block to the homepage and/or all pages (as a global include).

findings.title: All sitemap lastmod dates are identical build timestamps
findings.description: All 1,979 URLs share only 6 unique lastmod timestamps differing by milliseconds (2026-07-14T16:29:22.303Z through .309Z). This indicates a build-time timestamp rather than per-page modification dates. Google uses lastmod to determine crawl priority; identical dates provide no signal.
findings.recommendation: Generate accurate per-page lastmod dates. Blog posts should reflect their actual publish/modified dates. Products should reflect last inventory or price change. Static pages can use a fixed date.

findings.title: All sitemap priority values set to 0.7 regardless of content type
findings.description: Every URL in the sitemap has priority 0.7. Standard practice: homepage=1.0, categories=0.8, products=0.5-0.6, static pages (privacy, returns)=0.3-0.4, blog listing=0.8, blog posts=0.6.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate priority values based on content importance. Homepage should be 1.0, category pages 0.8, product pages 0.5-0.6, static policy pages 0.3.

findings.title: Missing offers.url and priceValidUntil in Product offers
findings.description: The `offers` block is missing `url` (recommended for Google to link offer to the page) and `priceValidUntil` (helps Google determine offer freshness).
findings.recommendation: Add `"url": "https://www.bazaarnow.net/product/SLUG/"` and `"priceValidUntil": "2027-12-31"` (or a dynamically computed date) to the offers object in each Product schema.

findings.title: Article image uses relative URL
findings.description: The Article schema `image` property uses a relative path (`/images/blog/cod-pakistan.jpg`) instead of an absolute URL. Same issue as Product images.

findings.title: Organization schema missing description
findings.description: The Organization block has no `description` property. This is used by Google to summarize the entity in knowledge panels and by AI systems for entity understanding.
findings.recommendation: Add `"description": "Pakistan's most trusted online marketplace - premium products at unbeatable prices with free delivery across Pakistan."`

findings.title: Missing ItemList schema on category pages
findings.description: Category pages list products but have no structured data indicating this. Adding ItemList helps Google understand the page as a collection of products.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList schema to category pages enumerating the products listed.

findings.title: No image tags in sitemap
findings.description: Although the sitemap declares the `xmlns:image` namespace, no `<image:image>` tags are used. For an e-commerce site with 1,964 products each having 3-5 images, this is a missed opportunity for Google Images discovery.
findings.recommendation: Add `<image:image><image:loc>https://...</image:loc></image:image>` tags within each product URL entry, or create a separate image sitemap.

findings.title: FAQPage present but Google retired FAQ rich results
findings.description: FAQPage schema is correctly implemented but Google retired FAQ rich results for ALL sites on May 7, 2026. No SERP feature is generated. However, the markup remains beneficial for AI/LLM citation and entity resolution.
findings.recommendation: Do NOT remove FAQPage markup. It still aids AI/LLM understanding. If adding new FAQPage purely for Google SERP benefit, note there is none -- use only if GEO/AI visibility is the goal.

findings.title: All sitemap changefreq set to 'weekly'
findings.description: Every URL has changefreq=weekly. Static pages (privacy, returns) are unlikely to change weekly. Blog posts may change less often. Products can change daily (price/stock).
findings.recommendation: Set changefreq per content type: homepage=daily, products=daily, blog=weekly, categories=weekly, static pages=monthly.
